comparison.interpretation: Processing includes delivery/drain and existing memory queries. Setup, cache conditioning and cube checks are outside it. Differences are total pipeline costs, not isolated kernel times. Basic GPU cube content checks are not numerical-reference agreement. Logical payload bandwidth is not measured NIC/OST traffic. Cache-conditioning attempts and durations are reported per case for assessing fairness; conditioning is excluded from processing. No pooling with the prior node.

limitations: Processing excludes setup, cache conditioning, post-loop cube checks; differences are pipeline timings, not isolated kernels.
Cube shape/count/finite/nonzero checks are basic content validation, not numerical-reference agreement.
Three repeats on one node; do not pool with prior jobs. Profiles change BD count, GPU count and batch together, so not GPU-only scaling.
Cache check establishes local host-page residency only, not backend Lustre cache state.
NVML free-memory extrema are sampled, not guaranteed transient peaks.
